basics.name: Utpal Das
basics.label: Product & Growth Leader
basics.x_residency: Indian national with Permanent German residency
summary: Product and growth leader with 18+ years building and scaling automotive marketplaces, consumer platforms, and digital businesses across Europe.

Track record of owning customer journeys end to end: +23% conversion, 30% organic acquisition growth across 7 markets, 2x engagement, and lead-quality improvements at Europe's largest used-car marketplace.
Proven commercial impact: +30% subscription revenue and +50% vehicle contribution margin, with product, marketing, CRM and P&L ownership in one seat.
Currently Head of Digital Solutions, leading Product, Design, Engineering, and Marketing/PR, and contributing to Series D strategy.
x_highlights: Grew and led cross-functional growth organizations: 5 senior PMs, 3 app marketers, 2 business analysts, and 24 developers; 64 people across 7 teams.
Built AI/ML applications across computer vision, supply-demand prediction, consumer demand, sponsored listings, and agentic product initiatives.
Led operations digitization through partner platforms, digital handover, digital damage reporting, OCR fine handling, and supply-chain automation.
Contributed to IPO-readiness and leadership transitions, including an NYSE journey and a Series D fundraising strategy.

work.name: Cubonic GmbH
highlights: Lead four departments — Product, Design, Engineering, and Marketing/PR — unifying acquisition, engagement, and conversion initiatives under one organization.
Report directly to the CEO; lead product vision, AI strategy, roadmap, and execution across the digital ecosystem.
Accelerated go-to-market by 18 months through partnerships, platform redesign, and data-driven roadmap execution.
Contribute to Series D fundraising strategy and key P&L decisions while shaping AI-enabled platform and mobility initiatives.

work.position: Head of Product / Head of Apps
work.name: AutoScout24 GmbH
highlights: Owned the mobile and web customer journey across 7 markets, delivering +23% conversion and 2x engagement.
Grew organic acquisition by 30% through App Store and Play Store optimization and lifecycle campaigns.
Launched sponsored listings and App Search, which drove 15% advertising revenue growth.
Led 5 senior PMs, 3 app marketers, 2 business analysts, and 24 developers across growth, engagement, conversion, and revenue.

work.name: Cazoo / Cluno GmbH
highlights: Led product strategy across partner platform, purchasing, operations, remarketing, customer apps, and digital handover workflows.
Owned first-mile, mid-mile, and last-mile logistics, including planning systems and supply-chain automation.
Increased subscription revenue by 30% and vehicle contribution margin by 50%.
Built predictive supply-demand and operational-planning models with the data team.

work.name: ZEISS / Merz Technologies
highlights: Led product for automotive and avionics applications, including cockpit display hardware, diagnostic tools, and validation systems.
Developed testing frameworks and system validation tooling to improve reliability, quality, and compliance.
Managed 64 people across 7 teams spanning engineering, quality, and delivery.
